---
title: "Tax Beauty is in the Eye of the Beholder"
date: "2006-05-02"
categories: ["Economics"]
---

BCA President [Michael Chaney in the WSJ](http://online.wsj.com/article/SB114651903651440753.html?mod=opinion_main_europe_asia "Michael Chaney in the WSJ"), proving that international comparisons are what you make of them:

We are particularly concerned that there is no overarching plan or vision for Australia’s tax system…

Mr. Costello’s review, which has confirmed that key areas of the Australia’s tax system are not competitive and need immediate reform, provides the conceptual groundwork for a program of more comprehensive and sustained reform.

Unfortunately, Treasurer Costello intends the review as a rationalisation for inaction.
